analyst_view.overall: Crystal Palace (21st, 5 pts) and Real Sociedad (20th, 5 pts) are level just outside the play-off places, so both need points with two league-phase games left after this one. Palace sacked Pierre Sage last week and Thomas Frank lost his first game 3-2 at Coventry, with the club bottom of the Premier League; the numbers know nothing about the change. In Europe Palace are without Adam Wharton (red card) and Yeremy Pino (third yellow), which the numbers do not have, plus Ismaila Sarr, Chadi Riad and Takehiro Tomiyasu, while Jorgen Strand Larsen is doubtful with an ankle problem; Jean-Philippe Mateta's ban is a Premier League one. Real Sociedad miss Barrenetxea, Herrera, Odriozola and Aramburu, which the numbers count, and also Luka Sucic (illness) and Astiazaran, which they do not, with defender Mamadou Sarr doubtful. Norwegian referee Rohit Saggi (about 3.8 cards a game) is in charge and both sides play again in the league on Sunday, so some rotation is possible.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.3 goals (Palace 2.2) and already count Barrenetxea and Herrera out for Real Sociedad and Aramburu missing from their defence. They do not see that Palace lose Pino, one of their top scorers this season, and Wharton, their main passer, to UEFA bans, with Strand Larsen carrying an ankle problem, or that Sociedad lack Sucic, one of their two leading scorers. So I go lower, to about 3.0.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.2 corners, already nudged up for Real Sociedad's recent corner count (40 in six games) and for Palace conceding many lately. Losing wide players on both sides (Pino, Sarr, Barrenetxea) could trim crossing a little, but Frank's sides have usually leaned on set pieces and direct play, so nothing clearly points either way and I stay at 9.2.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.0 cards, already lifted for both sides' recent bookings (Palace 15 in six) and trimmed a little for referee Rohit Saggi's calm record (3.8 a game). Wharton and Pino, both recently booked or sent off, are out, but this is a tense game between two sides level on points, so I stay at 4.0.

shots.text: The numbers say 27.2 shots, with Real Sociedad's very busy recent shooting (106 in six games) already adding about 19% to their side. Palace lose two of their main creators in Pino and Wharton and Sociedad are without Sucic, none of which the numbers know, so I shade it to about 26.1.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.4 shots on target, already a bit lower for Palace's quieter recent attack. With Pino and Sarr out, Strand Larsen doubtful and Sucic missing for Sociedad, the quality of chances should drop a little, so I go to about 8.9.
